title: DAO Treasury Rebalancing with TWAP Execution
description: Execute DAO treasury rebalancing from 80% ETH / 20% USDC to 50% ETH / 30% USDC / 20% DAI per governance vote, using TWAP to minimize market impact.

mission.description: DAO treasury manager: execute governance-mandated treasury rebalancing with minimal market impact
constraints: Must use TWAP to minimize slippage
Complete within 7 days of governance vote (vote passed 2026-05-28)
Track all transaction costs for reporting

mission_prompt: The DAO treasury holds 10000 ETH ($25.2M at $2520/ETH) and 5000000 USDC ($5M). Governance vote TRE-2026-05 passed on 2026-05-28 mandating a rebalance to 50% ETH / 30% USDC / 20% DAI. Current allocations: ~83.4% ETH / 16.6% USDC. Target: 50% ETH, 30% USDC, 20% DAI. Total treasury value at current prices: $30.2M. Target amounts: $15.1M in ETH (~5992 ETH), $9.06M in USDC, $6.04M in DAI. You must sell ~4008 ETH for USDC and DAI using TWAP over the next 5 days. The deadline is 2026-06-04. Use a DEX aggregator (1inch, Cow Swap) and split into daily TWAP slices. Max 0.3% slippage per trade.

optimal_actions.action: Calculate target amounts: Target ETH = 5992 (from 10000, sell 4008 ETH). Target USDC = 9.06M (need to ADD 4.06M USDC). Target DAI = 6.04M (need to acquire 6.04M DAI from ETH sales).
optimal_actions.rationale: Total treasury = $30.2M. 50% ETH = $15.1M at $2520 = 5992 ETH. 30% USDC = $9.06M. We have $5M USDC, so need $4.06M more. 20% DAI = $6.04M. We need to sell 4008 ETH to get ~$10.1M, which will be split into $4.06M USDC and $6.04M DAI.

optimal_actions.action: Design TWAP schedule: 5 days, sell ~801.6 ETH/day in 4 hourly trades of ~200.4 ETH each
optimal_actions.rationale: Split 4008 ETH across 5 days (Mon-Fri) = 801.6 ETH/day. Each day: 4 trades of ~200.4 ETH every 6 hours. 200.4 ETH at $2520 = ~$505K per trade. Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC 0.05% pool has $450M liquidity and $520M daily volume — a $505K trade represents ~0.1% of daily volume, well within the 0.3% slippage budget.

optimal_actions.action: Split each day's USDC and DAI targets: 60% of daily sale to USDC, 40% to DAI
optimal_actions.rationale: Need $4.06M USDC and $6.04M DAI from $10.1M total sales. 4.06/10.1 = 40.2% to USDC; 6.04/10.1 = 59.8% to DAI. Each daily sale of 801.6 ETH: ~322.2 ETH swapped to USDC, ~479.4 ETH to DAI.

optimal_actions.action: Execute via Cow Swap for MEV protection and 0.3% avg slippage
optimal_actions.rationale: Cow Swap's batch auction mechanism protects against MEV and frontrunning. With $340M 24h volume, our $505K per-trade orders represent 0.15% of daily volume — executed within market depth. Cow Swap also offers limit-order-like protection through its solver network.

optimal_actions.action: After each daily batch, verify: ETH remaining, USDC and DAI balances, cumulative slippage, gas costs
optimal_actions.rationale: Track progress against target: after Day 1, ETH should be ~9198.4 ETH (started at 10000, sold 801.6). Continue tracking to ensure final allocation hits 50/30/20 within tolerance.

alternative_actions.strategy: Use 1inch aggregator with direct routing through Uniswap V3 0.05% pool
alternative_actions.steps: Execute same TWAP schedule via 1inch API, routing through Uniswap V3 for USDC and Curve for DAI
alternative_actions.tradeoff: 1inch adds 15% gas overhead vs direct swap but may find better routing across multiple DEXes; however, Cow Swap's MEV protection is more valuable for large treasury trades

alternative_actions.strategy: Single large OTC trade via institutional desk
alternative_actions.steps: Contact FalconX or Wintermute for an OTC swap of 4008 ETH → USDC + DAI at a fixed spread
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Faster execution (1 trade), potentially lower total fees but requires KYC and trusted counterparty; misses the governance requirement for transparent on-chain execution

risk_flags: ETH below 200-day MA ($2650) — selling into a downtrend may amplify losses if price rebounds
High correlation between all three assets in volatile market — stablecoins may depeg during stress
TWAP failure risk: if a single trade reverts (gas spike, pool manipulation), the schedule is disrupted
DAI has lower liquidity in ETH pair ($120M Uni V3) vs USDC ($450M) — DAI trades may experience higher slippage
Governance deadline (2026-06-04) is fixed — if market conditions prevent trading on any day, remaining days require larger slices (exceeding 0.3% slippage)

mission_alignment_check.reason: TWAP execution respects governance mandate, slippage constraints, and deadline. Splitting into daily batches minimizes market impact while ensuring completion within 7 days.

known_hallucination_cases: Agent might claim 'TWAP guarantees zero slippage' — TWAP distributes but does not eliminate slippage; each individual trade still incurs price impact
Agent might claim 'Cow Swap has zero fees' — Cow Swap has settlement fees paid to solvers; there is no protocol fee but solvers earn spread
Agent might claim 'selling 4008 ETH in one trade on Uniswap V3 is safe' — a single trade of 4008 ETH (~$10.1M) on the 0.05% pool would cause ~2-3% slippage, far exceeding the 0.3% limit
Agent might claim 'DAI can be acquired directly from MakerDAO at $1' — the Peg Stability Module (PSM) allows 1:1 USDC-to-DAI but not ETH-to-DAI directly; ETH must first be swapped to USDC
Agent might claim 'TWAP is implemented natively in Cow Swap' — TWAP is a strategy pattern, not a native feature; it must be implemented as a series of limit orders or a custom smart contract
reasoning_path: Step 1: Parse governance mandate — compute target allocations from passed proposal parameters
Step 2: Calculate current vs target: ETH 10000 (83.4%) → 5992 (50%) means sell 4008 ETH; USDC $5M (16.6%) → $9.06M (30%) means buy $4.06M more; DAI $0 → $6.04M (20%) means acquire
Step 3: Design TWAP schedule respecting slippage constraint — use pool liquidity data to size individual trades
Step 4: Select routing strategy — Cow Swap for MEV protection
Step 5: Implement monitoring — track cumulative progress, slippage, and gas costs daily
Step 6: Verify final allocation against governance mandate within acceptable tolerance (±1%)

success_criteria: TWAP strategy properly designed with trade sizing rationale
Governance mandate correctly interpreted and executed

expected_failure_modes: May propose single large swap exceeding slippage budget
May miscalculate target amounts (confuse percentages or total value)
May ignore DAI liquidity constraints vs USDC
May forget to account for existing 5M USDC when computing required stablecoin purchases
May claim inherent protocol features that don't exist (e.g., built-in TWAP)
May retrieve stale liquidity data for trade sizing
May suggest Aave or Compound as routing option for spot swaps
May overestimate Cow Swap volume if RAG data is outdated
